title: Handmade by God
story:
A potter once worked carefully on a clay vessel.

He shaped it with steady hands.

He pressed gently when needed.

And smoothed it patiently.

One of the vessels asked,

“Why do you keep shaping me like this?”

The potter smiled and said,

“Because I know what I am making you into.”

“If I stop too early, you will not be complete.”

The vessel did not understand at first.

But over time, it became strong and beautiful.

In life, we often question our process.

We wonder why we go through difficulties.

Why shaping takes time.

But God is our Creator.

He made us with intention.

He is forming understanding in us.

And He is shaping us according to His Word.
life_lesson:
You are created by God with purpose.

Trust His shaping process in your life.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me with care and purpose.

Help me to trust Your process in my life.

Give me understanding to follow Your ways.

Shape me according to Your Word.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you going through a process you don’t understand?

How does it change you to know God is shaping you?

What area of your life do you need to surrender to Him today?
verse:
Your hands made me and formed me;
Give me understanding to learn Your commands.
